text:
Sara (support): Heads up — Acme Health opened a request for a Private deployment. They need VPC peering + an on-prem install option for PHI workloads. Asking: feasibility, minimal timeline, high-level checklist, and any blockers. Pasted their bullets below.

Alex (Acme Health): quick summary from our infra: need VPC mode with dedicated control plane in their VPC, option for air-gapped on-prem package for two data centers, KMS/HSM support, audit logs pushed to their SIEM, and a 99.9% uptime SLA. Want an initial POC in 4–6 weeks if feasible.

Luca (sales): Thanks — they are a green-account and want this to be contracted if POC looks good. Sales handoff: we need scope + risk list to build a commercial proposal. :eyes:

Maya (PM): High-level triage: two tracks — (A) VPC-managed Private (control plane in Redwood but network peered or endpoint in their VPC) and (B) On-prem air-gapped bundle. Each has different effort. Start with feasibility + blockers.

Jon (eng-infra): Quick notes from infra POV: VPC mode we already have base support for (Private with VPC) but customer asks for control plane components inside their network — that’s extra. On-prem installer: we have an internal prototype for k8s helm-based package but not hardened / supported for enterprise airgap installs.

Nina (solutions): From pre-sales calls: must support BYOK/KMS (AWS KMS & external HSM), token-level audit logs to Splunk, and ability to pin model versions. They will not accept traffic egressing outside their DC for PHI.

Tara (legal): Note — PHI + on-prem triggers Business Associate Agreement + additional security review. Legal needs the full design to sign off. Expect 1–2 weeks for contract adjustments after technical spec.

Sara (support): Can we assemble a minimal dependency checklist and an ETA (best/likely/worse) for both tracks? Sales needs to tell Acme a realistic POC start date.

Jon (eng-infra): Dependency checklist (first draft):
• Network: VPC endpoints or private link + route tables, IP allocation plan, DNS configuration.
• Control plane placement: decide hosted-in-customer vs customer-managed; impacts auth and rollout.
• Install bundle: airgap tar + k8s manifests, installer scripts, docs.
• Secrets/KMS: BYOK integration + support for HSM; rotation process.
• Logs/Monitoring: forwarder to customer SIEM (TLS + mTLS).
• RBAC & multi-tenancy: tenant isolation options + token scoping.
• Compliance: audit log formats, retention.
• Support model: on-call for install window and runbook.

Maya (PM): Nice. For timelines: if we scope minimal viable POC features (VPC peering, KMS, logs to SIEM, model pinning) I estimate:
• Best-case: 3 weeks (if we reuse existing Private stack + minor infra config)
• Likely: 6–8 weeks (legal review + packaging + infra changes)
• Worst: 12+ weeks (if we need on-prem airgap hardening and HSM integration work)

Nina (solutions): POC acceptance criteria (proposal):
1) Deployed Private instance reachable from their app tier (VPC connectivity validated)
2) BYOK used for all key ops and key rotation demoed
3) Audit logs delivered to their SIEM with sample queries
4) Model pinned and inference validated against their test prompts (latency within SLA)
5) Runbook for failover/backout and support RTO/RPO defined

Luca (sales): Can we mark which items require product commitment vs professional services? We charge for PS time but product must own core infra changes.

Jon (eng-infra): Quick split: product/core infra must provide supported installer and control-plane options (hosted-in-customer or customer-managed). PS would handle on-site install assistance, config tuning, and documentation tailoring. HSM integration likely requires product work + vendor-specific adapters (shared-cost decision).

Tara (legal): Also flag data retention and logging levels — customers may request special retention windows for PHI. Legal will need that parameterized.

Maya (PM): Action items:
• Jon: produce a one-page technical feasibility doc + rough estimate for VPC-hosted-in-customer vs on-prem bundle (due in 3 business days).
• Nina: create POC test plan and confirm required sample prompts + dataset access from Acme (due EOD tomorrow).
• Tara: list legal checklist for PHI + BAA items (due 2 business days).
• Luca: ask Acme to confirm target POC date window and which datacenter they want first.
• Sara: open a product-backlog intake card with priority tag and link to this thread.

Jon (eng-infra): I'll also flag the internal gaps: installer automation, airgap packaging, and documented rollback. If we accept this we should add a spike for HSM vendor adapters.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-private-vpc-proto rollback window 02:00-04:00 UTC — no impact expected.

Alex (Acme Health): Thanks all — we can provide a small set of sample prompts and a dedicated infra contact. Preferred POC start: 6/5 -> 6/19 window. Happy to sign NDA/BAA asap.

Maya (PM): Good — tentative decision: prioritize VPC-hosted-in-customer POC first (lower risk), evaluate on-prem airgap as follow-up. We'll reconvene after Jon's feasibility doc.

Luca (sales): I'll update Acme and push for contracting milestone tied to POC success.

Sara (support): I'll create the backlog ticket now and tag this thread. TL;DR: feasible but several deps (installer, KMS, legal). ETA for POC start: ~6 weeks likely, 3 weeks optimistic if no blockers.

Nina (solutions): :thumbsup: I'll prep the test corpus template and a checklist for the POC environment.

Jon (eng-infra): Adding one more tech note — if control plane runs inside customer network we need a sync mechanism for updates; rolling upgrades plan required. That's part of the feasibility doc.

Maya (PM): Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll track progress on the intake card.

(End of thread)
